items.title: The Amazing Inventions of Ancient Greece: From Plato’s Alarm Clock to Ancient Flamethrowers
items.summary: Pla­to’s water alarm clock is just one of the pieces of advanced ancient Greek tech­nol­o­gy explained in the new video above from Lost in Time, a YouTube chan­nel whose look at ancient Roman tech­nol­o­gy we post­ed here on Open Cul­ture last year. Most of the oth­ers were invent­ed for less gen­tle pur­pos­es: we have a nasty-look­ing flamethrow­er on wheels meant to breach stone fortress­es; a “machine gun” able to fire arrows much more rapid­ly than any bow­man; a nine-sto­ry-tall pro­to-tank ful­ly stocked with cat­a­pults and sol­diers ready to swarm a city; and a gigan­tic claw, designed by no less a mind than Archimedes, able to grab and over­turn invad­ing war­ships.

items.title: Deep Rock Galactic Season 7 puts a gravitational twist on the chaotic co-op game, and you can try it right now
items.summary: Rouse a chorus of 'Rock and Stone,' because Deep Rock Galactic Season 7 has just been revealed in full by developer Ghost Ship Games, and there are plenty of reasons to dive back into one of Steam's most gleeful co-op games. The gravity-twisting update will force you to deal with unusual conditions as you attempt…

items.title: The Psychedelic Animated Video for Kraftwerk’s “Autobahn” (1979)
items.summary: Ah, yes, “Autobahn.” From the moment the door slams and the ignition starts, prog rockers and pre-new wavers know a journey is afoot. Though Kraftwerk had already made three albums, and the band members still looked like well-meaning, bookish hippies, 1974’s “Autobahn” is considered Year Zero for the denizens of the Electric Café, the four German robots who made human music with machines. This cel-drawn animation by Roger Mainwood was made in 1979 to promote “Autobahn,” after most of the culture had caught up with the song, and it’s now bopping around pop culture again.

items.title: Tecnam Flies Four People Into North America’s Highest Airport
items.summary: Tecnam recently completed a demonstration flight of its diesel-powered P2010 TDI to Lake County Airport in Leadville, Colorado, carrying four people to an airport nearly 10,000 feet above sea level. According to a company announcement Thursday, the aircraft departed Leadville after refueling and used less than half of the airport’s 6,400-foot runway during takeoff. Lake County Airport sits at an elevation of 9,934 feet, making it the highest public-use airport in North America. High-elevation airports present particular challenges for piston aircraft, especially when temperatures increase density altitude.

items.title: Texas, New Mexico Spaceports Propose 250-Mile Supersonic Flight Corridor
items.summary: Four organizations have signed a letter of intent to develop a dedicated supersonic flight testing corridor between Texas and New Mexico. The agreement, announced Wednesday, involves Midland Development Corporation, Midland International Air & Space Port, the New Mexico Spaceport Authority and Starfighters Space. The proposed corridor would extend approximately 250 nautical miles between Midland International Air & Space Port and Spaceport America, crossing sparsely populated areas of West Texas and southern New Mexico.

items.title: The Best Places to Go in Central and South America 2027
items.summary: This is my fourth year leading our guide to the Best Places to Go in Central and South America, and each time I’m in awe of the final result—our list for 2027 is no exception. We’re talking about a region where the Pacific, the Atlantic, and the Caribbean converge; where the Andes reach for the Amazon; and where strings of puffy volcanoes and postcard-worthy islands stud the map like jewels. Within it all there are thriving cities where cultures ancient and modern collide head-on, and small towns that are timeless in a way that feels increasingly rare.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: How we’re addressing safety risks of distillation and lessons we’ve learned for strengthening safeguards across the industry. As frontier AI models become more capable, safeguards play an increasingly important role in how they can be used responsibly. Adversarial distillation creates a path for bad actors to reproduce these capabilities without appropriate safeguards. An actor may use a frontier model’s outputs without authorization to train another model with similar capabilities, then deploy it without comparable protections.

items.title: Look: North Carolina highway covered in spilled corn
items.summary: The North Carolina Department of Transportation warned drivers that a lane of highway was closed Friday due to a corn spill in the road.

items.title: Look: Florida police find reported garage 'intruder' was runsaway pig
items.summary: Police in Florida responded to a report of a breaking and entering at a resident's garage and arrived to find the suspect was a runaway pig.

items.title: AI boom threatens circuit board crunch to rival pandemic-era chip shortage
items.summary: The electronics industry faces a printed circuit board (PCB) shortage that could rival the pandemic-era chip crunch – with AI once again accused of hogging supplies. The Global Electronics Association says demand is arriving "at a scale the supply chain was not built for," straining everything from glass fabric and resin to finished boards. Its report, " The PCB Squeeze: A Wake-Up Call for Global Electronics," says AI servers need increasingly complex boards. While a typical PC board has about 12 layers of tracks, AI server boards can have 40 to 60 layers or more, and each additional layer requires more resin, copper foil, and laminate.

items.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
items.summary: Anthropic's shares have dropped back towards their initial price after a soaring first day on the stock market, as a wider tech sell-off dragged markets down. The sell-off comes as concerns remain over the speed and size of artificial intelligence investment, but also as some large companies including Nvidia and SpaceX faced specific issues that worried investors. Those pressures combined to weigh on US markets through Friday, with all key US indexes closing sharply down on the day, furthering earlier falls over the week.

items.title: JetBrains Plugin Developer Conf 2026: Watch All the Talks
items.summary: JetBrains Plugin Developer Conf 2026 took place on November 10, bringing together JetBrains experts and plugin developers for a day of technical talks, practical examples, and discussions about the latest in plugin development. This year’s program explored how AI and agents are influencing plugin development, alongside new IntelliJ Platform APIs, language support, plugin architecture, and development across different environments. Missed the conference or want to revisit a session? All talk recordings are now available on YouTube!

items.title: First Chair on the PNW’s Largest Resort, Last Call on the Deschutes: Why Bend Is the West’s Best Ski Town
items.summary: Snowbanks start lining the road a few miles past the last roundabout on Century Drive. It’s moderately dark out, and you have a piping hot coffee in your hand from Backporch Coffee Roasters. Ponderosas start thinning into hemlock as the road gains elevation. A few miles from the Mt. Bachelor parking lot, the 9,000-foot cone of the stratovolcano itself shows up dead ahead. Some people call this view from this particular spot in the road the “hallelujah curve.” On a wintertime trip to Bend, this is when the stoke really sets in.

items.title: Outdoor Research Austera Alpine Down Hoodie Review
items.summary: Bottom Line The Outdoor Research Austera Alpine Down Hoodie delivers substantial warmth for its 16.2-ounce weight and allows good shoulder mobility when reaching overhead. Its lofty 850-fill insulation and Pertex Quantum Diamond Fuse shell make it a useful cold-weather layer, while the two-way zipper and helmet-compatible hood are practical for climbing. We found the shell sheds water in light rain, but that is not a substitute for a waterproof rain layer. The two-way main zipper, helmet-compatible hood, and large internal mesh pockets are useful climbing-oriented details, though our assessment centered on the features and fit rather than a documented high-altitude trip.

items.title: Google Donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to the CNCF to Secure AI Agents at Scale
items.summary: Google has announced it is donating Agent Substrate and gVisor to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), placing two important components of its AI agent infrastructure under vendor-neutral open-source governance. The move is intended to address two emerging challenges in running autonomous agents at scale: securely executing untrusted, AI-generated code and managing the substantial compute overhead created by agents that frequently pause and resume. The announcement also includes OpenRL, Google's open-source reinforcement learning orchestration project.

items.title: The best things in open source are built together
items.summary: In 2026, public contributions on GitHub soared to 2.5 billion, more than double last year’s total of 1.12 billion. It goes to show how open source remains a powerful mechanism for developers to build, share, and grow communities. Open source is how I began my GitHub journey. I contributed to Processing Foundation by adding alt-text to images on the p5.js website. This was the first time I felt included in a software development space as someone with a background in traditional fine arts and design.

items.title: These US fishers see offshore wind as a ‘godsend’. Trump wants to shut it down
items.summary: Despite the president’s attacks, Sea Services is training New England fishers in offshore wind construction and providing them with a second income stream On a rainy September morning, the Pamela Ann, a rusty, 86ft (26-metre) scallop boat, docked in New Bedford, Massachusetts. Its crew had spent the past 12 days at sea, recording mammal sightings, monitoring vessels to ensure they didn’t enter construction zones, and keeping watch over workers at Revolution Wind, a 65-turbine offshore wind project just south of Rhode Island. “God forbid, if anybody was to fall, we could be there to help them out,” said Capt Kevin Souza, who has a bulldog tattoo on his shin to mark his time in the navy.

items.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
items.summary: TLDR; Inkling 2 Mini is a new looped transformer model. It’s a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts with ~26B physical total and 3B active parameters per token. It uses a neat trick to increase capacity: some layers are visited in a loop that repeats three times, which makes it work like it had more parameters. It supports a 1M-token context size, accepts images and text inputs. Thinking Machines Lab ships the model in a mixed-precision format, with NVFP4 and MXFP8 expert weights. A DSpark drafter is also included for additional speed-up at a small memory cost.

items.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
items.summary: Combining RL on a custom task distribution with your favorite agent harness yields more accurate and efficient models for that target harness and task distribution. Models are not fully optimized for all harnesses and the tasks you’re doing. Instead, they target general performance. So when you combine a model and harness, you’re leaving performance and efficiency on the table for the stuff you’re actually doing. With RL, you can train a custom harness adapter that squeezes everything out of your model for your harness and task combination.
